narrative: Aktia's income is a driver model, and almost all drivers already live in Snowflake: AUM and fee rates, FTP curves, card volumes per segment and product, and account commissions. The MOPS price lists are the one gap — still in Oracle. AUM is a record €18.2bn (blended fee rate 0.42%) with €124M of Q3 net sales. A −50 bp Euribor shock costs about €8M of 2027 NII; +5% AUM adds €3.5M; a 3% price-list change adds €1.8M.
